# Each entry = one "coder".  K = runs per deal.  reason=False drops the one-sentence rationale to save output tokens

]

# ---- Run the coders in parallel.  One API call per deal per model returns K sampled codings (n=K). ----
done = set()
if os.path.exists(OUT_PATH):
    prev = pd.read_csv(OUT_PATH); done = set(zip(prev.deal_id, prev.model)); print("already coded:", len(done), "deal-model pairs")

todo = inputs.dropna(subset=["agency_quotes"])
if DRY_RUN: todo = todo.head(3)
jobs = [(r, m) for _, r in todo.iterrows() for m in MODELS if (r.deal_id, m["model"]) not in done]
print(len(jobs), "deal-model calls to make")

def code_one(r, m):
    sys_prompt = CODEBOOK if m["reason"] else CODEBOOK.replace(', "reason": "<one sentence>"', "")
    resp = None
    for attempt in range(4):
        try:
            resp = client.chat.completions.create(
                model=m["model"], temperature=1.0, n=m["K"], max_tokens=90 if m["reason"] else 40,
                response_format={"type": "json_object"},
                messages=[{"role": "system", "content": sys_prompt}, {"role": "user", "content": deal_prompt(r)}])
            break
        except Exception as ex:
            time.sleep(4 * (attempt + 1))
            last_err = ex
    out = []
    if resp is None:
        return [dict(deal_id=r.deal_id, company=r.company, model=m["model"], run=-1, code=None, group=None, confidence=None, reason=f"API_ERROR: {str(last_err)[:120]}")]
    for i, ch in enumerate(resp.choices):
        try:
            j = json.loads(ch.message.content)
            out.append(dict(deal_id=r.deal_id, company=r.company, model=m["model"], run=i, code=str(j.get("code", "")).upper()[:2],
                            group=str(j.get("group", "")).upper()[:1], confidence=j.get("confidence"), reason=j.get("reason")))
        except Exception:
            out.append(dict(deal_id=r.deal_id, company=r.company, model=m["model"], run=i, code=None, group=None, confidence=None, reason="PARSE_ERROR"))
    return out

rows, n_done, t0 = [], 0, time.time()
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=WORKERS) as ex:
    futs = [ex.submit(code_one, r, m) for r, m in jobs]
    for f in as_completed(futs):
        rows += f.result(); n_done += 1
        if n_done % 50 == 0:
            pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(OUT_PATH, mode="a", header=not os.path.exists(OUT_PATH), index=False); rows = []
            print(f"{n_done}/{len(jobs)} calls done, {time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
if rows: pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(OUT_PATH, mode="a", header=not os.path.exists(OUT_PATH), index=False)
